title: Recall the symmetry tests
text: Replace $$(r,\theta)$$ in the equation. If $$(r,-\theta)$$ or $$(-r,\pi-\theta)$$ gives the same equation, the graph is symmetric about the x-axis. If $$(-r,-\theta)$$ or $$(r,\pi-\theta)$$ gives the same equation, it is symmetric about the y-axis. If $$(-r,\theta)$$ or $$(r,\theta+\pi)$$ gives the same equation, it is symmetric about the origin.

title: Apply the tests
text: Replacing θ with -θ gives $$1+cos\left(-\theta\right)=1+cos\left(\theta\right)$$, so the graph is symmetric about the x-axis. The graph is a cardioid that points to the right, so it has no symmetry about the y-axis or the origin.
